source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Συνέσιος ο εν Λύση της Κύπρου αθλήσας»

attestations.note: The page behind the line says «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Οσίου» — we have no details of the venerable one's life — so the whole of what is recorded is in the line itself: that he contended at Lysi in Cyprus. The etymology block over the name adds «Συγγραφέας από την Κυρήνη του 4ου μ.Χ. αιώνα», a writer from Cyrene of the fourth century, which is the site's note on other bearers of the word and is not attached to this man; no date is taken from it. No relic, no distich and no hymn.
